messages.content:
Arabica beans are generally considered higher quality and have a sweeter, softer taste with tones of sugar, fruit, and berries.

Also worth knowing: Robusta beans contain roughly twice the caffeine of Arabica beans — around 2.7% vs 1.5% by weight.
